checks: Eight concurrent openings across two API processes create one shift and one stable response
Barber checkout records branch, service provider, collector and one durable owner notice on retries
Custody is private to the collecting barber and branch; mixed card money is never cash
Receiving the same handoff eight times moves custody once and preserves sales and commission
Cash movements require exact cents, a reason, an open branch and a durable key
Blind closing never exposes its expectation before counting, including printable capabilities
Blind close separates mixed payments and custody from physical cash and treats one cent as a difference
Commission settlement persists a receipt and cannot pay the same selection twice
Partial refund after a closed shift restores one unit, reverses a historical commission and keeps paid history
Partial returns do not reprice when the product price and barber commission change
Paid commission adjustments remain pending and cannot disappear in a zero-clamped payroll
Refund permissions, reason, foreign branch and excessive quantity fail before stock changes
Concurrent new-key refunds cannot restore the same last unit twice
A sale concurrent with closing belongs wholly to that shift or to the collector, never half-committed
Custody from a prior closed shift is received into a new shift without a new sale
A late refund database failure rolls back stock, commission, cash, customer and intention; the same key recovers once
A tip-only remainder can be refunded without restocking an already returned unit
The next payroll must include past paid-sale reversals and offsets them without changing the earlier receipt
Free units and a fully discounted sale can be returned without prematurely cancelling outstanding units
Refunding an already attended appointment preserves the prior CRM visit
The real working database is untouched
datos: Ficticios; dos procesos API; sin pagos reales ni cambios a la base de trabajo
